author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Need gamemode name.

Enderplosion; A TDM with 12 teams, jump pads, TNT, invisibility in certain areas, and your only weapon is a bow that fires enderpearls. You have 3 lives and have 2 classes; one with jump boost, and another with speed. Health kits and portals included. Point based game, you gain points by killing players and breaking their color coded orb with shears. Cannot place blocks, only break blocks.
